headlines.title: Watch: Spain witnesses first total solar eclipse in 27 years
headlines.description: NBC News’ Raf Sanchez reports on the ground in Spain as crowds revel and cheer at the total solar eclipse taking place during the sunset hour.

headlines.title: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt to step down
headlines.description: Leavitt, 28, is the youngest person to serve in the role. She will leave the Trump administration at the end of the month.

headlines.title: Nick Reiner pleads not guilty to murder charges in stabbing deaths of parents Rob and Michele Reiner
headlines.description: Nick Reiner has been indicted on murder charges in the deaths of his parents, Rob and Michele Reiner, in a stabbing attack inside the family’s Brentwood home in December.

headlines.title: Two dead after military Apache helicopter crashes near Fort Hood in Texas
headlines.description: Two people have been killed after an Apache helicopter crashed and burst into flames near Fort Hood in Texas, according to officials. NBC News' Dan De Luce reports.

headlines.title: Lakers to be sold to Bob Iger and Josh Kushner for $12 billion
headlines.description: The Los Angeles Lakers are being sold to an ownership group led by Josh Kushner and former Disney CEO Bob Iger reportedly for a $12.5 billion. NBC News' Steve Patterson reports on the new ownership group buying the franchise that had just been bought in late 2025.

headlines.title: Trump Addresses Elaborate Plane Swap Ruse to Keep Him Safe
headlines.description: New comments from President Donald Trump confirm that he secretly swapped planes as he left an international summit because of a threat from Iran. A U.S. official tells NBC News that the threat included the possibility of the Iranian regime targeting the president with a shoulder-fired missile. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Two people are dead after a military helicopter crashes in Texas, sparking a fire
headlines.description: Two people who were on board a military helicopter were killed Wednesday when it crashed in Salado, Texas, the Bell County Sheriff’s Office said.

headlines.title: Extremism expert charged in case on Southern Poverty Law Center informants
headlines.description: A former official at the Southern Poverty Law Center is now facing federal charges in connection with a case the Justice Department brought over the way the organization made payments to informants who provided details on extremist organizations.

headlines.title: Arkansas trooper threw teen down and punched her in the face during traffic stop, lawsuit says
headlines.description: An 18-year-old Black woman filed a lawsuit this week against an Arkansas State Police trooper she said “slammed her to the ground and struck her in the face” during a traffic stop.
